tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Bar and panel background. The ground everything else sits on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised areas: popups, control centre, cards, toasts, OSD.

tokens.name: surfaceAlt
tokens.usage: Hover fill, inactive slider track fill, pressed-adjacent states.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px rules and popup borders; also the pressed fill. Decorative only (1.4–1.6:1 on grounds) — never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: tick
tokens.usage: Ruler baselines and scale ticks. Meaningful non-text, so ≥3:1 on bg / surface / surfaceAlt: light 3.46 / 3.82 / 3.05, dark 3.79 / 3.53 / 3.10. Never for text.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surfaceAlt and line (≥11:1 both themes). Also the 2px occupied-tag marker.

tokens.name: textMuted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, section eyebrows, focused-window title, date, inactive icons. On bg / surface / surfaceAlt: light 6.81 / 7.50 / 5.99, dark 8.13 / 7.57 / 6.66.

tokens.name: textFaint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, ISO week numbers, empty tags, disabled controls. On bg / surface / surfaceAlt: light 5.25 / 5.78 / 4.62, dark 5.89 / 5.49 / 4.83 — passes AA.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Swiss red. Marks exactly ONE thing per view: focused tag, focus ring, primary action, slider fill, active device bar. As text on bg / surface / surfaceAlt: light 5.24 / 5.77 / 4.61, dark 5.61 / 5.22 / 4.59.

tokens.name: onAccent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill: light 5.77:1, dark 5.61:1. Never use white on the dark accent (3.46:1).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Connected / healthy state, always with an icon or word. Text on bg / surface only in light (4.85 / 5.35); on surfaceAlt it is 4.27 — fails AA, use it there only for icons.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Degraded state: weak Wi-Fi, high CPU or GPU temperature. Text on bg / surface only in light (4.92 / 5.43); on surfaceAlt it is 4.33 — fails AA, icons only there.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Critical or failed state (disconnected, critical notification). Same value as accent; always paired with an icon or word, never colour alone.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Big numbers only: the control-centre clock. Tabular figures. Geist has no optical-size axis, so the -2% tracking does the tightening.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: Ruler numerals in the bar: the focused tag number and the clock's hours and minutes. Tabular. One step up the 1.25 scale from h2.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text; notification body (textMuted) and summary (weight 600).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Bar text, tag numbers, small labels. Clock uses weight 600.

styles.name: caps
styles.usage: Section eyebrows, toast app names. Always set UPPERCASE.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Geist Mono: metadata and machine text — counts, reset times, session status ("2 active sessions", "resets in 2h 57m · Thu 05:00"), IPs, paths, the layout symbol, arrows, box-drawing. Never for labels or headings.

spacing.note: 8px base unit. s1 (4px) only for icon/text optical alignment. No other values exist.

tokens.name: s0
tokens.usage: Flush edges: popups sit flush on the bar's bottom rule.

tokens.name: s1
tokens.usage: Half-step, optical alignment of icons and text only.

tokens.name: s2
tokens.usage: Base unit. Toast stack gap, panel grid gutter, icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: s3
tokens.usage: Row padding inside lists (device rows, network rows).

tokens.name: s4
tokens.usage: Bar side padding, gap between bar modules, date-to-clock gap.

tokens.name: s5
tokens.usage: Popup inner padding, panel outer margin, gap between bar groups.

tokens.name: s6
tokens.usage: Space between panel sections.

tokens.name: s7
tokens.usage: Large separation inside the control centre.

tokens.name: s8
tokens.usage: Largest step; media art edge.

radius.note: Square geometry, plus one true circle for on-states. No rounded rectangles.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Every corner: bar, popups, tiles, buttons, slider handles, toasts, OSD.

tokens.name: radiusCircle
tokens.usage: Circles only, on square boxes: the on/selected mark. Nothing else is rounded.

size.note: Structural dimensions from Theme.qml, plus the ruler: ticks on a 4px step (4 / 8 / 16), 8px pitch on heading rulers, 12px on the tag ruler.

tokens.name: barHeight
tokens.usage: Bar height and exclusive zone.

tokens.name: barPadX
tokens.usage: Bar left/right inner padding.

tokens.name: moduleGap
tokens.usage: Gap between modules inside a bar group.

tokens.name: groupGap
tokens.usage: Gap between bar groups.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and popup borders.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: State bars: occupied/urgent tag bars, active device bar, critical toast bar, slider track, progress, focus outline.

tokens.name: iconBar
tokens.usage: The one icon size, bar and panels alike. Swiss Glyphs are drawn on a 16px grid; any other size breaks pixel alignment.

tokens.name: iconPanel
tokens.usage: Equals iconBar. Kept as a token so Theme.qml can still address panel icons separately; do not set it to a non-multiple of 16.

tokens.name: hitTarget
tokens.usage: Minimum width and height of anything clickable.

tokens.name: sliderHandle
tokens.usage: Square slider handle.

tokens.name: markCircle
tokens.usage: The on / selected mark: a filled ink circle (on) or a 2px ink ring (off). Selected device, toggle on.

tokens.name: markTriangle
tokens.usage: The attention mark: a solid ink triangle. Urgent tag cap, near-limit meter flag.

tokens.name: mediaArt
tokens.usage: Square-cropped media art.

tokens.name: popupWidth
tokens.usage: Popup, toast and control-centre width (48 × 8).

tokens.name: osdWidth
tokens.usage: Volume OSD width.

tokens.name: osdHeight
tokens.usage: Volume OSD height.

tokens.name: panelColumns
tokens.usage: Panel grid: 6 columns, s2 gutter, s5 outer margin. Calendar uses a 7-column variant.

tokens.name: tickW
tokens.usage: Width of baselines and scale ticks.

tokens.name: tickMinor
tokens.usage: Minor tick: every rulerPitch on a heading ruler, every 10% on a slider scale, a module start on the bar rule.

tokens.name: tickMajor
tokens.usage: Major tick: the origin of every ruler, 0 / 50 / 100% on a slider scale, the bar rule's first tick.

tokens.name: tickValue
tokens.usage: The value tick (2px wide, `marker`) that ends a slider or meter fill and is the slider's handle.

tokens.name: rulerFill
tokens.usage: Slider and meter fill, centred on the 1px baseline (1px above, 1px below).

tokens.name: rulerPitch
tokens.usage: Tick spacing on heading rulers — the grid unit, made visible.

tokens.name: rulerShort
tokens.usage: Length of a heading ruler: four pitches.

tokens.name: tagPitch
tokens.usage: Spacing between tag ticks in the bar's tag ruler.

tokens.name: tagTickEmpty
tokens.usage: Empty tag tick height (`tick` colour).

tokens.name: tagTickOccupied
tokens.usage: Occupied tag tick height (`text`).

tokens.name: tagTickActive
tokens.usage: Focused tag tick height (`accent`) — the bar's one accent.

tokens.name: npTextMax
tokens.usage: Now Playing title slot, maximum width (24 grid units ≈ 31 characters of Geist at 12px). Shorter titles shrink the slot; longer ones scroll inside it.

tokens.name: marqueeGap
tokens.usage: Gap between the end of a scrolling title and its repeat (s7).

tokens.name: marqueeSpeed
tokens.usage: Scroll speed, in px per second (4 grid units a second). Constant, linear, never faster for longer text.

tokens.name: progressW
tokens.usage: Now Playing progress: an ink line drawn on the bar's bottom rule under the title slot.

duration.note: Motion tokens. Theme.reduceMotion sets every duration to 0. Easing: Easing.OutCubic / Easing.InCubic in QML.

tokens.name: durFast
tokens.usage: Hover, colour change, theme switch.

tokens.name: durMed
tokens.usage: Popup open/close: opacity 0→1 plus 8px vertical translate.

tokens.name: durSlow
tokens.usage: OSD fade.

tokens.name: easeOut
tokens.usage: Enter (Easing.OutCubic).

tokens.name: easeIn
tokens.usage: Exit (Easing.InCubic).

tokens.name: marqueeHold
tokens.usage: Pause before a title starts scrolling and after each loop returns to the start.

tokens.name: drawerOpen
tokens.usage: Tray drawer slide (same as durMed). Instant under reduceMotion.
